name: Korean Street Addresses
description: Road-name addresses in Hangul from the province down, with the dong in brackets, floors, blocks and units, the older lot-number form, the postcode first in brackets or last, and addresses in Latin letters from the number up. Original cases written for this corpus from Korea Post's road-name address guidance, described in our own words; the postcodes and their provinces are GeoNames' (CC BY 4.0).
